messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — Bluefrost just sent a consolidated ask. They want a joint POC + tech handoff. Main items: SSO (SAML), choice of Private (VPC) vs Dedicated sandbox, pricing options (reserved vs usage), security questionnaire answers, and shared telemetry/alerts. Can we triage and list owners?

Alex: I can take the technical POC runbook. Quick clarifying q: do they require EU data residency or are US regions fine? Also need expected throughput (QPS) and typical context length.

Maya: Scheduled a prep call with Bluefrost for Thu 10am PT, inviting their infra lead + product. I'll collect their questionnaire ahead of time.

Samir: Tech notes: we can stand up either a Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity) or a Private deployment in their VPC via our Private package. For SAML we support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. Example SP metadata snippet we send them: 
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="false" WantAssertionsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Also: for Private we require outbound egress to our artifact + metrics endpoints (10.0.0.0/16 in their peering by default) and an IAM role for instance provisioning. We can enable prefix/KV caching and token-bucket throttles to hit their latency SLOs.

Priya: Security intake: please have them fill the vendor security questionnaire (I'll attach our template). We can provide: SOC 2 Type II report, latest penetration test summary, architecture diagram, and an export of encryption-at-rest details (we support CMK via KMS/HSM). We generally do not provide raw request logs; we can provide aggregated telemetry and trace exports for the POC. If they need deeper access, we can discuss a limited-log-sharing SLA.

Lee: Ballpark pricing for a 2-week POC: Dedicated sandbox with 2xA100 equivalent ~ $6,000 for reservation, or usage-based ~$3,000 depending on token volume. If they commit 3 months we can offer ~15% discount and include higher telemetry retention. Need token/day estimate to firm up. Also confirm entitlements — will they be an OEM integrator (resell) or a direct customer? licensing path changes pricing.

Alex: For the runbook I'll prepare terraform/helm snippets to provision the sandbox and a sample workload profile (200 rps gen, 4k context). Will also include failover to hosted small-model fallback.

Maya: Bluefrost asked about an enablement session for their SREs during the POC. Can we schedule a 60-min deep-dive (infra + ops + SSO) on week 1?

Samir: Yes — I can do the ops deep-dive and demo the KV/prefix caching. Plan: infra doc + commands + sample alert rules. Example alert rule: `error_rate > 0.5% for 5m` triggers oncall.

Priya: I'll prepare the security pack and a short checklist for them to complete before we provision access (vendor questionnaire + IP allowlist + contact for incident ops).

deploy-bot: Created support ticket ZD-32178 "Bluefrost joint POC — tech triage" and assigned to #poc-ops. https://zendesk.example.com/agent/tickets/32178

Jordan: Great. Owners & next steps: Alex = infra/runbook, Priya = security pack, Lee = pricing options and entitlement path, Maya = schedule + bluefrost coordination, Samir = ops deep-dive materials. I'll ping Bluefrost with the plan after the prep call. :thumbsup:

Alex: Noted — I'll drop the runbook draft in the ticket by EOD tomorrow.

Priya: Ping me if they have any high-risk data categories (PHI/PCI) — that changes scope.

Maya: Will send the pre-call questionnaire link in the calendar invite.

Jordan: Thanks team — we'll sync after Thu call.
